fullContentHtml:
Short Information : National Co-operative Bank Ltd. (NCBL) has released the notification for the post of Clerk. This recruitment has been issued for 15 posts. Online applying process for National Co-Operative Bank NCBL Clerk Recruitment 2024 has started from 04 December 2024 & the candidates can apply till 18 December 2024. Candidates must check the complete details for National Co-Operative Bank NCBL Clerk Recruitment 2024 which has given below. 

National Co-operative Bank Ltd. (NCBL)

National Co-Operative Bank NCBL Clerk Recruitment 2024

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 04 December 2024
  • Application Start Date : 04 December 2024
  • Last Date : 18 December 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 December 2024
  • Exam Date : January 2025

Application Fee

  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

  • Age Limit As On 01 November 2024

  • Age Relaxation as per National Co-Operative Bank NCBL Clerk Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

National Co-Operative Bank NCBL Clerk 2024 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 15 Posts

Post Name  No. of Post
Clerk 15

National Co-Operative Bank Clerk Bharti 2024 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates having Graduate in any stream from any recognized university / college will be considered for this post.
  • Banking experience.
  • Adequate knowledge of computer applications.
  • Must be fluent in Marathi, English & Hindi.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

 NCBL Clerk Online Form 2024 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://www.nationalbank.co.in or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the National Co-Operative Bank NCBL before Last Date.
